core_idea: propose a clamped normal-light dot-product sequence that preserves geometry cues while excluding material influence and can be converted back to normals with OLS.
method_preview: treat the sequence as a video, use an image-to-video generative model, recover normals with OLS, and train on MultiShade for complex materials and lights.
result_preview: claim superior performance to state-of-the-art methods without reporting a number, uncertainty, or failure count.
contribution_list: enumerate the new paradigm, RoSE with canonical parallel lights and analytic derivation, and MultiShade plus multi-dataset SOTA results.

credit_or_foundation and gap_creation: cite photometric-stereo work showing learned features resemble shading sequences, then make sequence supervision the training target.

context: positions MLLMs as spatial-intelligence systems and contrasts explicit 3D representations with the scalable RGB/video paradigm.
missing_insight: identifies omitted camera intrinsics, derives projected-height equivalence, and connects the ambiguity to cross-camera shortcuts.
result_preview: previews dense camera embedding, camera-aware augmentation, geometric-prior distillation, and cross-camera evaluation.
contribution_list: restates theoretical/empirical diagnosis, the Camera-Aware MLLM framework, and extensive verification as three contributions.
positioning_only/taxonomy: groups general MLLM work by visual modality, alignment, and task capability without a component-level contrast.
nearest_neighbor_contrast: contrasts point-cloud/3D routes, RGB-only spatial MLLMs, and VLA models, then locates this work within RGB-only.
gap_creation: uses MMDE’s cross-camera failures and intrinsics-aware successes to motivate transfer of camera-awareness to MLLM spatial reasoning.
state_problem: frames unknown intrinsics as the information deficit behind camera-specific shortcuts.
contrast_alternative: rejects Metric3D-style canonicalization for MLLMs because of invalid visual tokens and scarce precise K.
define_component: introduces Geometry-Aware Visual Encoder and the multimodal path from text/frames to the LLM.
derive: maps each visual-token grid coordinate through camera intrinsics to normalized ray components.
explain_mechanism: adds sinusoidal camera embeddings and fuses them with visual features by element-wise addition.
connect_to_prediction: varies scale and principal point while synchronizing image and K to force disentanglement.
define_component: distills a dense 3D point cloud from frozen UniDepth v2 into a geometric-prior embedding.
connect_to_experiment: uses UniDepth’s image-based intrinsic estimation to cover inputs with unknown camera parameters.
summarize: presents camera-awareness as the bridge from pixel processing to transferable geometry.
context：列出现有 instruction-based editors，把自然语言编辑连接到用户 aesthetic intent。
problem：指出强编辑器仍依赖 continuous user involvement 和精确的 sequential instructions。
failure_of_prior_work：拆出 expertise barrier、algorithm selection、interaction complexity 三种用户侧失败。
missing_insight：提出 autonomous editing agent 应模拟人类 photo editor 的工具选择、动作排序和结果判断。
core_idea：用 people-loop/agent-loop 对比引出 exploratory visual aesthetic planning、closed-loop evaluation 和 rollback。
method_preview：给出 perceiver、MCTS planner、executor、evaluator 四组件，并加入 tool-selection 与 memory。
gap_creation：把 generic image-quality data 与 authentic UGC 之间的评价缺口单独提出。
method_preview：用 UGC-Edit、learned reward model 和 1,017-photo test set 回答评价缺口并预告三类证据。
contribution_list：以系统、long-horizon planner、UGC-Edit/reward/test set、全面实验四项并列收束。
taxonomy：按 GAN/encoder-decoder、diffusion/flow/MLLM editors 划分 image-editing 技术路线。
limitation_of_prior：指出现有生成模型多是 single-step static executors，依赖低层 prompt。
taxonomy：把 AlphaGo/MCTS、HuggingGPT、ReAct、Voyager 放入 autonomous-agent planning 线。
nearest_neighbor_contrast：说明 JarvisArt、MonetGPT、PhotoArtAgent 主要用 LLM 调 procedural tools 做低层 retouching。
gap_creation：将 T2I latent/text search 与 instruction-based image editing 区分，落出 MCTS internal simulation/external execution 的缺口。
taxonomy：把 PSNR/SSIM full-reference 与 FID/aesthetic/CLIP no-reference metrics 分开。
limitation_of_prior：指出 generic no-reference signals 难捕捉 UGC 的 fine-grained aesthetic differences。
gap_creation：以 specialized UGC dataset 和 reward model 承接评价缺口，避免在相关工作中提前复述完整方法。
setup_notation：定义当前图像状态 I_t、动作集合和代表 image state 的 tree node。
state_problem：把高层/模糊审美意图转为连续语义动作，并由 evaluator 决定下一状态是否接受。
define_component：Perceiver 以 LLaVA/Qwen3-VL 和 structured context-aware multimodal prompt 生成 atomic actions。
explain_mechanism：prompt 支持 autonomous/user-guided、scene type inference、人物保护和 static strategy memory。
define_component：Planner 用 MCTS 选择 actions，并明确 selection、expansion、simulation、backpropagation 四阶段。
instantiate_algorithm：UCT 平衡探索/利用，leaf 由 perceiver 扩展，simulation 用低分辨率 rollout，backprop 更新 Q/N。
connect_to_prediction：以 Appendix A 的 resolution alignment 支撑低分辨率 simulation 的 sim-to-real 叙事。
define_component：Executor 将 top-K actions 路由到 OpenCV/PIL basic tools 或 FLUX.1 Kontext/Step1X-Edit。
define_component：Evaluator 组合 no-reference、CLIP/instruction-following 和 customizable perceptual models，比较 candidate 与前一状态。
summarize：有改进则保留最高分结果，无改进则 rollback；达到 max steps 或不再变化时终止。
